body:
MOVIE ARCHITECTURE — CURRENT CONSENSUS AND GATES (2026-08-30 12:45Z)

CANONICAL LANDED BASIS
- Plan: docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md at landed hash b12f79c... until a successor lands.
- One shared narrative ontology for text and movies. Movie work adds evidence, clocks, tracks, and acquisition below the shared graph.
- Raw media evidence -> persistent modality observations/features -> joined proposals and critic findings -> deterministic resolution -> shared narrative graph.
- Fuse interpretations late; retain evidence early. Providers propose only. Fully automatic means unresolved, alternative, unsupported, partial, and failed states are first-class; it does not mean silently forcing a label.

DURABLE ARTIFACTS AWAITING CHIEF LANDING
- Component-admission ledger cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H, commit f203b783, exact one-path blob eb3caa99: both reviews approve; sole blocker is chief authorization/landing.
- D2 time contract cand-38WBVZ221RZFMWTEA6GA9EPF3G, commit f6d57a17, exact two paths: one formal approval; scout formal review, chief authorization, and stale ancestor-candidate reconciliation remain. Content itself has exact-byte V6 approval from both reviewers.

D2 SETTLED CONTENT
- Presentation is an edition playback axis, not a native picture clock.
- PTS and DTS are independent optional coordinates; zero duration is unknown, never a sentinel.
- Preserve signed ticks, origins, epochs, wrap/reset/discontinuity, gaps, and repeated occurrences.
- Mapping relations have stable identity distinct from derivation receipts; reverse maps may be conditional or set-valued.
- Quantized/enclosing/refused mappings are typed; arithmetic or quantization refusal is distinct from gap, outside-domain, no-correspondence, ambiguity, and missing evidence. Tolerance is not equality.

P1 BASEBALL DIAGNOSTIC
- v3 accepted by independent estimand review at post-01M19B15C4F4Q3E4VYP4Z05P87 and ready for chief promotion.
- Eligibility is outcome-independent. Y_sv is posterior probability of any predeclared faithful or source-anchored distorted visit. Omission is 1-Y_sv only for eligible participant-by-situation cells; missing evidence is not omission. Revisitation is separate.
- Promotion must spell Accessibility_v, emit typed InsufficientSupport/NotEstimated below frozen support, and derive N_sv from the same admitted visit predicate as Y_sv.

B0 OWNER-ONLY GATE
- Still open: pyannote gated terms; MF2 NC-SA decision; Sherlock artifact license; FilmFestival exact edition/participant/REB basis; human recall-corpus REB and redistribution.
- No restricted download, terms acceptance, participant prose, episode video, or source-corpus admission is authorized.

CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION BOUNDARY
- Reusable now: word/token traversal and windows; feature tracks, reducers, derivations, sidecars, boundaries; proposals/critics/deterministic resolution; NarrativeCompilation; shared graph/hierarchy/trajectory; renderer-neutral Atlas/Codex packets.
- Existing AudioSpan/TranscriptTurn.audio is only a millisecond transcript overlay.
- Missing: SourceBundle, edition-aware PresentationAxis/MediaAtlas, multimodal evidence anchors, timed-language lattice, audiovisual tracks, worker schemas, and FFmpeg/PySceneDetect runtime.

NEXT EXECUTABLE ORDER
1. Chief lands the two documentation candidates and promotes P1.
2. Owner closes B0 decisions.
3. C1 begins only under an explicit bead: provider-free source substrate, clock/evidence contracts, and text/timed-transcript conformance before runtime acquisition.
4. F0 synthetic media first; F1 admitted BBB excerpt plus pinned LGPL FFmpeg and weightless PySceneDetect next; speech and learned providers remain separate later gates.
5. SourceFrozen validation and transcript-only/visual-only/audio-only/full/one-shot contrasts precede scientific claims.

OUTPUT CONTRACT
- Movie packets expose source/media availability, edition and native coordinates, story-world/recall/scanner axes, and checked mappings. Preview code may seek only through checked mappings; it may not infer missing synchronization.
